prompt: Create an original 60 second chamber classical instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: string quartet, clarinet. Style: interlocking counterpoint and expressive legato. Tempo approximately 78 BPM; D major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A classical chamber piece featuring strings and woodwinds, with a melancholic yet hopeful and dramatic progression. It transitions between slower, reflective passages and more dynamic, expressive sections.
description.zh: 一首古典室内乐作品，以弦乐和木管乐器为主，情感上从忧郁到充满希望，并带有戏剧性的发展。乐曲在缓慢、沉思的段落和更具活力、表现力的部分之间切换。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
